author: Bar Winkler
title: Wonderful Italy
bodyHtml:
Wonderful is opening its first office in Italy, bringing the next generation of AI agents to a country that has always been a global benchmark for creativity, style, and excellence.

Italy presents a complexity all its own: a territory of a thousand accents, cadences, and dialects, where language is rich, nuanced, and deeply tied to identity. For enterprises, this diversity makes scaling customer operations uniquely challenging - every interaction must feel personal, human, and culturally attuned.

At the same time, Italy is home to some of the world’s most iconic companies in fashion, luxury, automotive, energy, and telecommunications, enterprises that demand solutions capable of matching their global influence and uncompromising standards. Wonderful enters this stage with a clear mission: to harness AI that speaks the language of Italy in all its forms, while delivering measurable impact and setting new benchmarks for customer experience worldwide.

“Opening in Italy is more than a geographic expansion - it’s a statement. Wonderful enters a market where language is not just a tool of communication but an expression of culture and identity. By embracing this complexity, we can help Italy’s leading enterprises transform their operations with AI that is multilingual, human-centered, and built to perform at a global scale.”

Carlo De Matteo
General Manager, Wonderful Italy

Wonderful is already working with organizations across financial services, telecommunications, fashion, hospitality, retail, and the public sector. Each partnership demonstrates how AI can create a meaningful impact when it is grounded in local knowledge and global expertise.

We’ve built a team on the ground and continue to expand. Explore our Careers page to see open roles and join us in shaping the future of enterprise AI.
